name: q7_condition2_balance
title: Condition 2: ²D against its band
caption: Condition 2 per cohort in the three pre-specified configuration sets A, A·W·T and A·U (F is drawn in q7_family_conditions), ²D rarefied to 40 designs against the band of the same configurations shuffled among the cohorts. A red point is below the band.
source: human labelling (architecture, wings, tilt, propulsors) · PatSeer (priority date)
propulsor: unique aircraft per four-year priority cohort; 200 permutations, seed 42; ²D rarefied to 40 designs (300 draws); the partial cohort 2024-26 is hatched and not read
read: Dot: the cohort's ²D (how many large designs are in play) averaged over the rarefaction draws, whisker: the middle 95 % of the draws. Grey band: the middle 95 % of the ²D of the same configurations shuffled among the cohorts at random, cohort sizes kept. A red dot is below the band: fewer designs in play than chance gives, condition 2 met.
